integrity: Proof uses exact rational finite certificates for nine small parameter values and an analytic all-parameter inequality for the remaining values; finite checks are not extrapolated.
scientific_limitations: Bidirected equal-weight complete bipartite graphs with one part of size two and the other of size at least three only.
One initially blue vertex and simultaneous independent recipient-based updates only.
The general conjecture for both parts of size at least three is not established.
No independent audit; historical priority provisional.
title: Source-side optimality for randomized zero forcing on two-by-many bicliques
